text.tspan: Kubernetes in one picture: the 5 core ideas
Pods with label app=web · (4) cattle, not pets
A pod crashes → the controller sees 2 ≠ 3 → it creates a new pod with a new name and IP.
The Service still finds it by label. Nobody ran a command: that is self-healing.
